name: NIFTY and BANKNIFTY
note: Instruments the engine keeps subscribed at all times, whether or not a page shows them, so every session is journaled. mode: ticker (last price), quote (adds volume, VWAP, day OHLC, buy/sell quantity) or full (adds OI and 5-level depth with order counts). Indices carry no volume or book, so ticker is enough for them. `instruments` are always ticker: India VIX (21), BANKNIFTY (25) and FINNIFTY (27). BANKNIFTY's 14 banks are in Full mode too (5 are also in NIFTY). Index futures and options are not here: the recorder (src/engine/recording) picks them each trading day.
